safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (لم) particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; (تقتلوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, of istidrāk (rectification) — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of lākinna, accusative (manṣūb); (قتل) past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (رميت) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn … and (التاء) is the fāʿil; (إذا) an adverb of past time, mabnī, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رميت) before it; (رميت) like the first; (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ الله رمى) like «لكنّ الله قتل»; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) of cause (taʿlīl); (يبلي) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يبلي); (بلاء) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); (حسنا) naʿt (adjective) of «بلاء», accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلي) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did that", i.e. the killing and the throwing [Note: The implied verbal clause is conjoined to the clause of istidrāk: «لكنّ الله رمى».].
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (سميع) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لم تقتلوهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "You boasted of killing them, but you did not kill them".
The clause «لكنّ الله قتلهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لم تقتلوهم».
The clause «قتلهم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna.
The clause «ما رميت» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لم تقتلوهم».
The clause «رميت» (the second) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لكنّ الله رمى» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ما رميت».
The clause «رمى» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the (second) lākinna.
The clause «يبلي …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «إنّ الله سميع» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, with a sense of giving the reason (taʿlīl).

* Rhetoric:
The device of istidrāk (rectification) and rujūʿ (retraction): it is speech containing the word «لكن», and that is in His saying, Exalted is He: «فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ، وَما رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمى». The istidrāk has come in these words in two places, each of which is suited to taʿaṭṭuf (the turning-back of a word upon itself), for the words «تقتلوهم» and «قتلهم», and «رميت» and «رمى», turn back on one another. This is the closest istidrāk that occurs in speech, because its particle stands in the middle between the two words of the taʿaṭṭuf in both places.

* Benefits:
1- His saying, Exalted is He: «وَما رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمى».
History tells us that Ubayy ibn Khalaf began driving his horse forward until he came close to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and men of the Muslims went to intercept him in order to kill him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: "Stand back," so they stood back. The Messenger of Allah took his spear in his hand and threw it at Ubayy ibn Khalaf, and broke one of his ribs. Ubayy went back to his companions heavily, and they carried him when they turned back homeward, and they kept saying: "No harm [done]." When they said that to him, Ubayy said: "By Allah, had it been [dealt] to the people, it would have killed them. Did he not say: 'I shall kill you, if Allah wills'?" His companions set off with him, trying to revive him, until he died somewhere along the way and they buried him. Ibn al-Musayyab said: concerning that Allah revealed «وَما رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ» to the end.
(لكن) — a particle resembling the verb, which puts the noun in the accusative and the khabar in the nominative. The meaning of lākinna is istidrāk and tawkīd (emphasis): so istidrāk and tawkīd. Istidrāk, for example: «خالد كريم لكنه جبان» (Khālid is generous but he is a coward).
And tawkīd, for example: «لو زارني خليل لأكرمته لكنّه لم يزرني» (Had Khalīl visited me I would have honoured him, but he did not visit me).

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلكم) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted, its implied form being "ḥaqq" (true) [Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "(the matter is) ذلكم".], and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) is a particle of address, and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural; (الواو) conjunction; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (موهن) khabar, nominative; (كيد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الكافرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله موهن …) is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, its khabar omitted, its implied form being "ḥaqq" [Note: Al-Zamakhsharī said it is conjoined to (ليبلي), in the position of the genitive. Al-ʿUkbarī said it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "the matter is that Allah weakens …".].
The clause «ذلكم (حقّ)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause of the interpreted maṣdar and its khabar has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause, i.e. "that trial is true, and the weakening of the plot of the disbelievers is true".

* Morphology:
(موهن), an active participle from the quadriliteral «أوهن»; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:64-64.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of the accusative; and (ها) a particle of alerting; (النبيّ) a badal (substitute) from أيّ or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it, following it in the nominative in its outward form; (حسبك) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) — and (الكاف) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الله) the Name of Majesty, a khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) a conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty «[Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "حسبك" ... and the wāw conjoins clauses.]»; (اتّبع) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "he"; and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second-person pronoun.
The clause «النداء يأيّها ...» (the vocative) is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حسبك الله» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «اتّبعك ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).

* Benefits:
His saying, the Exalted: يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ.
حسبك: a mubtadaʾ, and the كاف is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is the khabar. It is also permissible that حسبك be a fronted khabar and الله, the Name of Majesty, a postponed mubtadaʾ. Ibn Hishām devoted a section in which he mentioned when we parse a sentence as mubtadaʾ then khabar, or khabar then mubtadaʾ. He said: The fronted of the two nouns must be judged to be the mubtadaʾ in three cases:
1- That both are definite, whether equal in rank, e.g. (الله ربنا), or differing, e.g. (زيد الفاضل) and (الفاضل زيد). This is the well-known view. It has been said: the reverse is permissible. And it has been said: the derived noun is the khabar even if fronted, e.g. «القائم زيد». 2- That both are indefinite and both fit to begin a sentence, e.g.: «أفضل منك أفضل مني». 3- That they differ in definiteness and indefiniteness, the first being the definite one, e.g.: زيد قائم. But if the first is the indefinite one, then if it has nothing that licenses beginning with it, it is the khabar by agreement, e.g.: خز ثوبك, and ذهب خاتمك. And if it has a licence, it is likewise [the khabar] according to the majority; Sībawayh, however, parses it as a mubtadaʾ if it has a licence, e.g.: كم مالك, and خير منك زيد, and حسبنا الله. Ibn Hishām says: In my view both ways are justifiable.

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها النبيّ) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In the previous verse (64).]»; (حرّض) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "you"; (المؤمنين) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (يكن) an imperfect verb, deficient (nāqiṣ) — an abrogator (nāsikh) — «[Note: Or complete (tāmm), its fāʿil being عشرون.]», jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of يكن «[Note: Or attached to (يكن) as a complete verb; and it may be attached to an omitted ḥāl of (عشرون) if the verb is complete.]»; (عشرون) the noun of يكن, postponed, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, since it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (صابرون) a naʿt (adjective) of (عشرون), nominative like it; (يغلبوا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; and the wāw is the fāʿil; (مائتين) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الواو) a conjunction; (إن يكن منكم مائة يغلبوا ألفا) like the first; (من) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of (ألفا); (كفروا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition of causation; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — «[Translator's note: the source prints «بافعل», evidently for «بالفعل».]»; and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of أنّ; (قوم) its khabar, nominative; (لا) negating; (يفقهون) an imperfect verb, nominative; and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The vocative clause «يأيّها النبيّ ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حرّض ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «إن يكن منكم عشرون ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or a resumption in the course of the answer.
The clause «يغلبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «إن يكن منكم مائة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause إن يكن منكم.
The clause «يغلبوا» (the second) has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يفقهون» is in the position of the nominative, a naʿt of قوم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم قوم) is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to (يغلبوا) in both places, i.e. because of their being ignorant.

* Morphology:
(عشرون): a noun for the first of the decades; it is treated like the masculine plural; its pattern is فِعْلُون, with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(الآن) an adverb (ẓarf) of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of the accusative, attached to (خفّف), which is a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (عن) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خفّف); (الواو) a conjunction; (علم) like خفّف, its fāʿil being "he"; (أنّ) like the previous one «1»; (فيكم) like عنكم, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of أنّ; (ضعفا) the noun of أنّ, postponed, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ فيكم ضعفا) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of علم.
(الفاء) resumptive; (وإن يكن منكم ... يغلبوا ألفين) like their two counterparts «2»; (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يغلبوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الصابرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «خفّف الله ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «علم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «إن يكن منكم مائة ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يغلبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «إن يكن منكم ألف» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن يكن منكم (the first).
The clause «يغلبوا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «الله مع الصابرين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ضعفا): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ضعف يضعف, of the pattern-class نصر and the class كرم; its pattern is فَعْل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other maṣdars from these two classes: from the class نصر there is ضُعْف, with ḍamma then sukūn, and from the class كرم there is ضَعافة, with fatḥa on the ḍād, and ضعافية.

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negating; (كان) a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (لنبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يكون) a deficient imperfect verb — or complete (tāmm) — accusative; (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar of يكون — or to (يكون); (أسرى) the noun of يكون — or its fāʿil (agent) — nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون ...) is in the position of the nominative, the noun of كان.
(حتّى) a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يثخن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتّى, its fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يثخن); (تريدون) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil being the wāw; (عرض) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الدنيا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil being "he"; (الآخرة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يثخن) is in the position of the genitive governed by (حتّى), attached to an omitted khabar of the deficient يكون «[Translator's note: the source prints «الناقض», evidently for «الناقص».]» — or to (يكون) as complete.
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) like the first; (عزيز) khabar, nominative; (حكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «ما كان لنبيّ ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكون له أسرى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يثخن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تريدون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «الله يريد ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تريدون.
The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «الله عزيز» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, «حَتَّى يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ». The original meaning of ثخانة is thickness and density in bodies; then it was borrowed for excess in killing and wounding, because, by preventing it from moving, it made him like the thick thing that does not flow. And it has been said: the metaphor is built on likening the said excess to thickness, in that each of them is, in general, a kind of intensity.

* Benefits:
The ransom of the captives of Badr:
ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd narrated: When it was the day of Badr, the captives were brought. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What do you say about these?" Abū Bakr said: "O Messenger of Allah, your people and your family; spare them and be patient with them; perhaps Allah will turn to them in forgiveness; and take from them a ransom that will be a strength for us against the disbelievers." And ʿUmar said:
"O Messenger of Allah, they called you a liar and drove you out, so let us strike their necks. Give ʿAlī power over ʿAqīl so that he strikes his neck, and give Ḥamza power over al-ʿAbbās so that he strikes his neck, and give me power over so-and-so, a kinsman of ʿUmar, so that I strike his neck, for these are the leaders of disbelief." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was silent and did not answer them. Then he went in, and some people said: "He will take Abū Bakr's view," and some people said: "He will take ʿUmar's view." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and said: "Allah softens the hearts of some men until they are softer than milk, and hardens the hearts of some men until they are harder than stones. Your likeness, O Abū Bakr, is that of Ibrāhīm, who said: Whoever follows me is of me, and whoever disobeys me, then You are Forgiving, Merciful. And your likeness, O ʿUmar, is that of Nūḥ, who said: My Lord, do not leave upon the earth any inhabitant of the disbelievers." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Today you are in need, so let none of them get away except by ransom or the striking of the neck." Ibn ʿAbbās said: ʿUmar said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ inclined to what Abū Bakr said, and did not incline to what I said." And on the next day the revelation came down upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bearing this verse:
ما كانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرى حَتَّى يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle «[Note: A particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd).]»; (كتاب) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the decree of a writ"; the khabar (predicate) is omitted obligatorily, its implied form being "موجود" (existing); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب «[Note: Or attached to (سبق).]»; (سبق) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "he"; (اللام) linking the apodosis of لولا; (مسّ) like سبق, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of «[Translator's note: the source omits the case here, evidently «جرّ», genitive.]», attached to (مسّكم), the referent pronoun being omitted, i.e. "أخذتموه"; (أخذتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (عذاب) the fāʿil of مسّكم; (عظيم) a naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The clause «كتاب من الله ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «سبق» is in the position of the nominative, a second naʿt of كتاب.
The clause «مسّكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أخذتم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).

* Rhetoric:
The device of causation (fann al-taʿlīl): in His saying, the Exalted, «لَوْلا كِتابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيما أَخَذْتُمْ عَذابٌ عَظِيمٌ». The device of causation is that the speaker, wishing to mention a judgement that has occurred or is expected, first mentions, before stating it, the cause of its occurrence, since the rank of the cause is to precede the effect. Here in the noble verse: were it not for a decree from Him, the Exalted, whose establishment preceded in the Preserved Tablet, namely that He does not punish a people before presenting what makes clear to them a command or a prohibition.

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive; (تستفتحوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (جاء) past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفتح) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) conjunction; (إن تنتهوا) like «إن تستفتحوا»; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خير); (الواو) conjunction; (تعودوا) like «تستفتحوا»; (نعد) imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty; (الواو) conjunction; (لن) particle of negation and of the accusative; (تغني) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); (عنكم) like «لكم», attached to (تغني) by its being made to include the meaning of «تدفع» (to ward off); (فئة) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, by the verb being made to include the meaning of «تدفع», i.e. anything of harm [Note: The verb may be taken to carry the meaning of «تنفع» or «تجدي» (to avail), and (شيئا) is then parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "your host will not avail you any availing" or "anything of availing".], (الواو) of ḥāl (circumstantial); (لو) a conditional particle that does not put into the jussive; (كثرت) past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "hiya", i.e. your host; (الواو) conjunction or resumptive; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of anna; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله مع المؤمنين) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did such-and-such because Allah …" [Note: The interpreted maṣdar may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the matter is that Allah is with the believers …", and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive.].
The clause «ان تستفتحوا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قد جاءكم الفتح» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن تنتهوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو خير لكم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن تعودوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نعد» has no grammatical position, being an apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لن تغني عنكم فئتكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كثرت» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from «فئتكم» [Note: The apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, namely His saying «لن تغني عنكم فئتكم».].
The implied clause «(فعل كذا)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لن تغني».

safi-cedvel:20-23.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of «أيّ» or naʿt (adjective) to it; (آمنوا) past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أطيعوا) imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (رسول) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, putting into the jussive; (تولّوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), one of its two tāʾs having been dropped, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عن) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تولّوا); (الواو) of ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تسمعون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يأيّها الذين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أطيعوا …» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «لا تولّوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تسمعون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تولّوا».
The clause «تسمعون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أنتم».
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (تكونوا) a deficient imperfect verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) —, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of «تكون»; (الكاف) a preposition; (الذين) a relative in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of «تكونوا»; (قالوا) like «آمنوا»; (سمعنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الواو) of ḥāl; (هم لا يسمعون) like «أنتم تسمعون» … and (لا) is negating.
The clause «لا تكونوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لا تولّوا».
The clause «قالوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «سمعنا …» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «هم لا يسمعون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «سمعنا».
The clause «لا يسمعون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle —; (شرّ) the noun of inna, accusative; (الدوابّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) «شرّ»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الصمّ) the khabar of inna, nominative; (البكم) a second khabar, nominative; (الذين) a relative in the position of the nominative as naʿt of «الصمّ البكم»; (لا يعقلون) like «لا يسمعون».
The clause «إنّ شرّ الدوابّ … الصمّ» has a position [as written: «لها محلّ لها»] in the sense of giving the reason (taʿlīl). [Translator's note: the source reads «لها محلّ لها», most likely a misprint for «لا محلّ لها» (has no grammatical position).]
The clause «لا يعقلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
(الواو) conjunction; (لو) a conditional particle that does not put into the jussive; (علم) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (في) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (علم) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from (خيرا).], (خيرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو»; (أسمع) past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الواو) conjunction; (لو) like the first; (أسمعهم) like the first; (اللام) like the first; (تولّوا) like «آمنوا»; (وهم) like the first; (معرضون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «لو علم الله …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إنّ شرّ الدوابّ».
The clause «أسمعهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put into the jussive.
The clause «لو أسمعهم …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لو علم الله».
The clause «تولّوا …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the second condition.
The clause «هم معرضون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تولّوا».

* Morphology:
(شرّ), an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral «شرّ يشرّ», of the pattern-classes [bāb] of نصر, ضرب and فتح; the hamza has been dropped from it for lightness, and «أشرّ» is sometimes said; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
[Translator's note: the source repeats «باب باب».]

* Benefits:
1- His saying, Exalted is He: «إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ». It is a kind of the device of tamthīl (representation by likeness), because it is more penetrating to the hearts and more able to take the minds by storm. The mention of this device and its standing in the Noble Qur'an has already passed with us.

safi-cedvel:24-25.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا استجيبوا) the i'rab of its like has already passed [Note: In verse (20) of this sūra.], (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استجيبوا); (الواو) conjunction; (للرسول) like «لله»; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis (jawāb); (دعا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent), i.e. the Messenger — and responding to the Messenger is responding to Allah —; (اللام) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of the genitive, attached to (دعاكم); (يحيي) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (كم) like the preceding, and the fāʿil is "huwa", and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (يحول) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يحول); (المرء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (قلب) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «المرء», genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله يحول …) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «اعلموا».
(الواو) conjunction; (أنّ) like the first, and (الهاء) a pronoun referring to Allah the Exalted [Note: The pronoun may be the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).] in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna; (الى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تحشرون), which is a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه إليه تحشرون) is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.
The vocative clause «يأيها الذين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «استجيبوا …» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «دعاكم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then respond to him".
The clause «يحييكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «اعلموا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «استجيبوا».
The clause «يحول …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna.
The clause «تحشرون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the (second) anna.
(الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like «اعلموا»; (فتنة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the cause of a trial"; (لا) negating; (تصيبنّ) imperfect verb, mabnī on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative because it is free of anything putting it into the accusative or jussive.. and (النون) is for emphasis [Note: The Basrans do not accept that an imperfect verb preceded by negating (لا) may be emphasised, and they interpret a verse like this as the verb being the response to an implied oath, the clause having no grammatical position, this oath being a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة», and the verb here is emphasised out of necessity.. This view is rejected by the Arabic texts of high style such as the Qur'an, since it is permissible to emphasise a verb negated by (لا). That being so.. some of them make the verb in the position of the jussive by prohibitive (لا), the speech being taken according to the meaning, i.e. "do not enter into the trial, for whoever enters into it, a general punishment comes down upon him".. and the clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech) of an implied [verb of saying] which is a naʿt of «فتنة», i.e.: "a trial about which it is said: let it not afflict …". The prohibition is, in wording, addressed to the affliction, and in meaning to those addressed.], (الذين) a relative, mabnī, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (ظلموا) past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil pronoun in (ظلموا); (خاصّة) ḥāl, accusative, from the fāʿil of «تصيبنّ», which refers to «فتنة», i.e. confined to them, or from the pronoun of «ظلموا», i.e. being singled out for this affliction [Note: It may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar by being an adjective of it, i.e. "a particular affliction".], (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا أنّ الله) like the first; (شديد) the khabar of anna, nominative; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «اتّقوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «استجيبوا».
The clause «لا تصيبنّ …» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of «فتنة».
The clause «اعلموا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «اتّقوا».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله شديد العقاب) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «اعلموا».

* Morphology:
(خاصة), a noun, the opposite of «عامّة» (general), or it is what includes one group to the exclusion of another; its pattern is فاعلة, and its ʿayn and lām are of one letter.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in His saying, Exalted is He: «وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ», which is a figure for the utmost nearness to the servant, because whoever separates between two things is nearer to each of them than the other is, being connected to both of them while one of them is separated from the other. The apparent view of many is that the speech belongs to the category of the representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya); it may also be a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya), so that the meaning of «يحول» is "to be near"; and it is not far-fetched that it belongs to the category of the compound non-metaphorical figure (majāz mursal murakkab), since it is used for a concomitant of its meaning, namely nearness.

* Benefits:
1- The grammarians differed concerning «لا» in His saying, Exalted is He: «لا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْكُمْ خَاصَّةً».
[They differed] between its being negating or prohibitive. The dispute among them branched out in a way we can do without mentioning.
We favour what the Arabic linguistic instinct supports and what the understanding of people of insight grasps at once, without resorting to alteration and supposition. So «لا» is negating, and the sense of the clause to everyone who hears it, free of strain and far-fetched interpretation, is that the trial, when it happens, does not afflict the wrongdoers alone, but afflicts the God-fearing along with them. And the story of that town, whose people Allah told that He would destroy all of them because of seventy men who transgressed against the command of their Lord in it — I say, the story of that town is not far from us, and its mention has already passed with us.

safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction; (كلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من) a preposition; (ما) like the previous one «[Note: In the previous verse (68).]», attached to (كلوا); (غنمتم) like أخذتم «[Note: In the previous verse (68).]»; (حلالا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative «[Note: It may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description, i.e. "an eating that is lawful".]», from the implied referent pronoun; (طيّبا) a second ḥāl, accusative, or a naʿt (adjective) of (حلالا), accusative «[Note: See verse (168) of Sūrat al-Baqara, where there are further ways of parsing.]»; (الواو) a conjunction; (اتّقوا) like كلوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative; (غفور) khabar (predicate), nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «كلوا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied clause that is its cause, i.e.: "I have made the spoils lawful for you, so eat of what you have taken as spoils."
The clause «غنمتم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كلوا.
The clause «إنّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīl) for the saying كلوا ... واتّقوا.

safi-cedvel:70-71.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها النبيّ) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (64) of this sūra.]»; (قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "you"; (اللام) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (قل); (في أيدي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من, the sign of the genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the yāʾ; and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من الأسرى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun «[Note: Or of the pronoun concealed in the implied ṣila.]», the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the alif; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (خيرا) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (يؤت) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter; and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being "he"; (خيرا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ممّا) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In the previous verse (69).]», attached to the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) (خيرا); (أخذ) a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (it), and it is the referent pronoun; (منكم) a preposition and a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أخذ); (الواو) a conjunction; (يغفر) like يؤت and conjoined to it; (لكم) like منكم, attached to «[Translator's note: the source leaves the governing word unnamed here, evidently (يغفر).]»; (الواو) a conjunction; (الله غفور رحيم) the i'rab of its counterpart has already been given «[Note: In verse (67) of this sūra.]».
The vocative clause «يأيّها النبيّ ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «إن يعلم الله ...» is in the position of the accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يؤتكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «أخذ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يغفر لكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يؤتكم.
The clause «الله غفور» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
(الواو) a conjunction; (إن يريدوا) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (62).]»; (خيانة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (خانوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من) a preposition; (قبل) a noun indeclinable on ḍamma in the position of the genitive, attached to (خانوا); (الفاء) a conjunction; (أمكن) a past verb, its fāʿil being "he"; (منهم) like منكم «[Note: In verse (66) of this sūra.]», attached to (أمكن); (والله عليم حكيم) the i'rab of its counterpart has already been given «[Note: In verse (67) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إن يريدوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer to the vocative.
The clause «قد خانوا ...» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis joined with fāʾ.
The clause «أمكن منهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن يريدوا.
The clause «الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمكن منهم.

* Morphology:
(خيرا) the first is a maṣdar (verbal noun), and (خيرا) the second is an elative from which the hamza has been dropped.

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the accusative, the noun of إنّ; (آمنوا) a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) a conjunction in the five places; (هاجروا، جاهدوا، آووا، نصروا) like آمنوا; (بأموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاهدوا); and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أنفسهم) like أموالهم and conjoined to it; (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاهدوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الذين) conjoined to the first; (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); and (الكاف) a particle of address; (بعض) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative; and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أولياء) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ بعض, nominative; (بعض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) a conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ; (آمنوا) like the first; (الواو) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion [to the past]; (يهاجروا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ما) a particle of negation; (لكم) like the preceding», attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (من ولاية) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء; and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; (حتّى) a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يهاجروا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتّى, the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn; and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) a conjunction; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (استنصروا) a past verb indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في الدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb (استنصروكم); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being a fronted khabar; (النصر) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (على قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted word which is the one in the accusative by exception, i.e. "except help against a people"; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to a fronted khabar; and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (بينهم) like the first and conjoined to it; (ميثاق) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الباء) a preposition, and (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, the referent pronoun being omitted, and the clause after it its ṣila.]»; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بصير) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to (بصير).
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هاجروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «جاهدوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «آووا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «نصروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آووا.
The clause «أولئك بعضهم أولياء» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «بعضهم أولياء» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «آمنوا» (the second) has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لم يهاجروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا (the second).
The clause «ما لكم ... من شيء» is in the position of the nominative, a khabar.
The clause «يهاجروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن), and the interpreted maṣdar (أن يهاجروا) is in the position of the genitive governed by (حتّى), attached to an omitted khabar of شيء.
The clause «استنصروكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «عليكم النصر» is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis joined with fāʾ.
The clause «بينكم ... ميثاق» is in the position of the genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.
The clause «الله ... بصير» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(آووا): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original form is آواوا. Two quiescent letters met, the alif and the wāw, so the alif was deleted and the letter before it given fatḥa as an indication of it. Its pattern is أَفْعَوْا, with fatḥa on the ʿayn. The madda in it has changed from two hamzas, the first vowelled with fatḥa and the second quiescent, i.e. أأووا, because the imperfect is يؤوي «[Translator's note: the source prints «يؤوى».]».
(ولاية): a noun meaning mutual allegiance in religion, i.e. help. The wāw may take kasra, and it then becomes a maṣdar (verbal noun), likened to the maṣdar denoting a craft or occupation. Its pattern is فَعالة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
What is to be noticed in His saying, the Exalted, وَالَّذِينَ آوَوْا وَنَصَرُوا, is that the verb آوى, when joined to the wāw of the plural, had its last letter deleted and the letter before the wāw given fatḥa. In this connection something will be clarified concerning the defective verb (nāqiṣ, i.e. one ending in a weak letter):
1- If the weak defective verb is joined to the wāw of the plural, its last letter is deleted, whether it is in the past, the imperfect or the imperative, e.g.: مشوا - يمشون - امشوا.
2- We look at the deleted letter: if it was an alif, we give fatḥa to the letter before the wāw of the plural, because the fatḥa is an indication of the deleted alif, e.g.: آووا - يرضون - ارضوا. But if the deleted letter was a wāw or a yāʾ, we give ḍamma to the letter before the wāw of the plural, e.g.: نسوا - يمشون - يعلمون - امشوا - ادعوا ... etc.
The same rule applies to these verbs if they are joined to the yāʾ of address: we give fatḥa to the letter before the yāʾ if the deleted letter was an alif, e.g.: أنت تنسين - انسي ... and the letter before the yāʾ takes kasra if the deleted letter was a wāw or a yāʾ, e.g.:
أنت تمشين - أنت امشي - أنت تدعين - أنت ادعي ...

safi-cedvel:73-75.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفروا) a past verb indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بعضهم أولياء بعض) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In the previous verse (72).]»; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (لا) negating; (تفعلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), namely taking the Muslims as allies and cutting off the disbelievers; (تكن) a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; (فتنة) the fāʿil of تكن, nominative; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فتنة; (الواو) a conjunction; (فساد) conjoined to فتنة, nominative like it; (كبير) a naʿt of فساد, nominative.
The clause «الذين كفروا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «بعضهم أولياء ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «تفعلوه ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تكن فتنة» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.
(الواو) a conjunction; (الذين آمنوا) like الذين كفروا ...; (وهاجروا وجاهدوا في سبيل الله) its i'rab has already been given «1»; (الواو) a conjunction; (الذين آووا) conjoined to, like the preceding «2»; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is (المؤمنون), the clause being the khabar of أولئك.]»; (المؤمنون) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (حقّا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) confirming the content of the preceding clause «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description, i.e. "the believers with a true belief".]», accusative; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (مغفرة) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الواو) a conjunction; (رزق) conjoined to مغفرة, nominative; (كريم) a naʿt of رزق, nominative.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الذين كفروا ...
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هاجروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «جاهدوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «آووا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «نصروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آووا.
The clause «أولئك ... المؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لهم مغفرة» is in the position of the nominative, a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) ... or in the position of the accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (المؤمنون), the governor of it being the demonstrative.
And (الواو) a conjunction; (الذين آمنوا) like the first; (من) a preposition; (بعد) a noun indeclinable on ḍamma in the position of the genitive, attached to (آمنوا); (الواو) a conjunction in both places; (هاجروا، جاهدوا) like كفروا; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to (هاجروا، جاهدوا); and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), added in the khabar because of the resemblance of the mubtadaʾ to a condition; (أولئك) like the first; (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar; (الواو) a conjunction; (أولو) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, since it is treated like the masculine plural; (الأرحام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (بعض) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative; and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أولى) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (في كتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أولى), i.e. more entitled in the judgement of Allah «[Note: al-Jamal in his gloss (ḥāshiya) allowed the preposition phrase to be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: this mentioned judgement is found in the Book of Allah.]»; (إن الله ... عليم) like إنّ الله غفور «[Note: In verse (69) of this sūra.]»; (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الذين كفروا..
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هاجروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «جاهدوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك منكم» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «أولو الأرحام ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding resumptive clause.
The clause «بعضهم أولى ...» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولو الأرحام).
The clause «إنّ الله ... عليم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اذكروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إذ) an adverbial noun, mabnī, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being «اذكروا» [Note: This is the view of al-Zamakhsharī, and Abū Ḥayyān rejected it, saying: it involves treating «إذ» as declinable by putting it in the accusative as an object, while it is one of the adverbs that are not so treated except by times being annexed to it … end quote. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: (إذ) is an adverb for what is governed by the verb «اذكروا», its implied form being: "and remember your state, existing or established, when you were few"; it may not be an adverb for «اذكروا»; «اذكروا» would only govern «إذ» if we took it to be an object.], (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (قليل) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (مستضعفون) a second khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مستضعفون); (تخافون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and one of the accusative; (يتخطّف) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الناس) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتخطّفكم الناس) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
(الفاء) conjunction; (آوى) past verb, mabnī on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) like the preceding, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الواو) conjunction; (أيّدكم) like «آواكم»; (بنصر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أيّدكم), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (رزقكم) like «آواكم»; (من الطيّبات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رزقكم); (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, of hope (tarajjī) — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (تشكرون) like «تخافون».
The clause «اذكروا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أنتم قليل …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تخافون» is in the position of the nominative as a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أنتم» [Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in (مستضعفون).].
The clause «يتخطّفكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آواكم» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «أنتم قليل».
The clause «أيّدكم …» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «آواكم».
The clause «رزقكم …» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «آواكم».
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

safi-cedvel:27-28.t:
* I'rab:
«يا أيّها الذين آمنوا» its i'rab has already passed; (لا تخونوا) like «لا تولّوا» [Note: In verse (20) of this sūra.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (الرسول) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, accusative; (الواو) conjunction [Note: Or it is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and the verb after it is accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after it, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding prohibition, i.e. "let there not be from you betrayal of Allah and the Messenger and betrayal of your trusts".], (تخونوا) jussive (majzūm), conjoined to the first (تخونوا); (أمانات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (وأنتم تعلمون) like «وأنتم تسمعون» [Note: In verse (20) of this sūra.].
The clause «يأيّها الذين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا تخونوا» (the second) has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تعلمون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أنتم».
(الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) like «اذكروا» [Note: In verse (26) of this sūra.] (أنّما) the restraining «ما» and the restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أموال) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أولاد) maʿṭūf to «أموال», nominative, and (كم) like the first; (فتنة) khabar, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (أنّ الله) its i'rab has already passed [Note: In verse (24) of this sūra.], (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أجر) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عظيم) naʿt (adjective) of «أجر», nominative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله عنده …) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of an implied «اعلموا».
The clause «اعلموا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The implied clause «(أعلموا)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the stated clause «اعلموا».
The clause «عنده أجر …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna.

* Rhetoric:
Istiʿāra (metaphor): in His saying, Exalted is He: «وَتَخُونُوا أَماناتِكُمْ». The meaning of «الخون» is diminution, just as the meaning of «الوفاء» (fulfilment) is completeness. From it is «تخوّنه», when one diminishes it. Then it was used for the opposite of trustworthiness and fulfilment, because when you betray a man in something you have brought diminution upon him in it. It has been used metaphorically, and it was said: «خان الدلو الكرب» (the rope-knot betrayed the bucket), and «خان المشتار السبب» (the rope betrayed the honey-gatherer) — «المشتار» is the gatherer of honey and «السبب» is the rope — and when the rope breaks in both cases, it is as though it did not keep faith.
The metaphor here is explicit (taṣrīḥiyya) and dependent (tabaʿiyya).

* Benefits:
1- The exegetes differed over the meaning of «الفرقان» with several views, the clearest and most preponderant of them being that it is a power of insight and a guidance in the intellect by which a person distinguishes between truth and falsehood.
2- The places where «إنّ» has a hamza with kasra.
Its hamza takes kasra wherever a maṣdar cannot properly stand in its place, and that is in twelve places:
a- That it occurs at the beginning of speech, as in «إِنَّا أَنْزَلْناهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ».
b- That it occurs after «حيث»: «تجلس حيث إن العلم موجود» (you sit where knowledge is present).
c- That it occurs after «إذ».
d- That it comes following a relative.
e- That it is the response to an oath.
And that it occurs after [a verb of] saying. [Translator's note: the source omits the letter (و, f) before this item.]
g- That what follows it is a ḥāl.
h- That what follows it is an adjective of what precedes it.
i- That it occurs at the head of a resumptive clause.
j- That the lām of ibtidāʾ occurs in its khabar.
k- That it, together with what is in its scope, occurs as a khabar about a concrete noun (ism dhāt).
l- That it occurs after deterrent «كلا», as in «كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَيَطْغى».
Some of these categories overlap with one another, so a single example may include two or three of the categories mentioned; so reflect and consider …

safi-cedvel:29-29.t:
* I'rab:
«يأيّها الذين آمنوا» its i'rab has already passed [Note: In verse (20) of this sūra.], (إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive; (تتّقوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (يجعل) imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. Allah; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يجعل) [Note: Or to an omitted second object of the verb «جعل» that takes two objects.], (فرقانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (يكفّر) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يجعل), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (عنكم) like «لكم», attached to (يكفّر); (سيّئات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يغفر لكم) like «يجعل لكم», being conjoined to it; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (ذو) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (الفضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (العظيم) naʿt (adjective) of «الفضل», genitive.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «تتّقوا …» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «يجعل …» has no grammatical position, being an apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يكفّر …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يجعل».
The clause «يغفر …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يجعل».
The clause «الله ذو الفضل …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); (يمكر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الباء) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يمكر); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (كفروا) past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (اللام) of cause (taʿlīl); (يثبتوا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يثبتوك) is in the position of the genitive, attached to (يمكر) … or to an omitted verb, its implied form being "they gathered".
(أو) a conjunction in both places; (يقتلوك، يخرجوك) like «يثبتوك» and conjoined to it; (الواو) conjunction in two places; (يمكرون) imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (يمكر) like the first, preceding one; (الواو) resumptive; (الله خير الماكرين) like «الله ذو الفضل» [Note: In the preceding verse (29).] … and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «يمكر.. الذين …» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يثبتوك» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يقتلوك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يثبتوك».
The clause «يخرجوك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يثبتوك».
The clause «يمكرون» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «يمكر بك الذين».
The clause «يمكر الله» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause «يمكرون».
The clause «الله خير الماكرين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- His saying, Exalted is He: «وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْماكِرِينَ», i.e. He turns back their plotting and makes its ill consequence fall upon them, or He requites them for it, or He deals with them as plotters are dealt with. So in the speech there is a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya), or a majāz mursal (non-metaphorical figure), or a representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya); and one may be content with pure mushākala (verbal correspondence).

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذا) an adverb of future time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قالوا); (تتلى) [Translator's note: the source gives no parsing for this word; it is a passive imperfect verb.], (آيات) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (سمعنا) past verb, mabnī on the sukūn … and (نا) is the fāʿil; (لو) a conditional particle that does not put into the jussive; (نشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; (اللام) linking the apodosis of «لو»; (قلنا) like «سمعنا»; (مثل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), its governor being «قلنا»; (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) particle of negation; (هذا) mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أساطير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الاوّلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «تتلى … آياتنا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put into the jussive.
The clause «قد سمعنا» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «لو نشاء» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لقلنا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put into the jussive.
The clause «إن هذا إلّا أساطير» has no grammatical position, being a resumption with the force of giving the reason (taʿlīl).

* Rhetoric:
The device of taghāyur (variance): in His saying, Exalted is He: «قَدْ سَمِعْنا لَوْ نَشاءُ لَقُلْنا مِثْلَ هذا». It is the variance of two positions, either concerning one meaning, such that a person praises a thing and blames it, or blames what another has praised, or the reverse; or he prefers one thing to another and then goes back and makes the inferior superior and the superior inferior. We say that the variance intended here is their varying from themselves: Quraysh said of the Qur'an: «ما سَمِعْنا بِهذا فِي آبائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ», as a denial on their part, because of the strangeness of its style and the eloquence of it that dazzled them; and this speech entails their admission of inability to imitate it. Then Quraysh varied from itself and said: "We have heard; «لَوْ نَشاءُ لَقُلْنا مِثْلَ هذا»". Had the two statements been at one time, that would have been a contradiction, which is a fault and would not be counted among the beauties [of style]; but its occurring at two different times and two separate moments was counted among the beauties, and for that reason it was called taghāyur and not contradiction.

* Benefits:
(قد) is a particle. If «قد» enters the past verb it conveys the realisation of its meaning, and if it enters the imperfect it conveys the infrequency of its occurrence; for example: (قد جاء خالد) (Khālid has indeed come), and (قد يجود البخيل) (the miser is sometimes generous).
And in the verse: «قد سمعنا».

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(وإذ) like the preceding [Note: In verse (30) of this sūra.], (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (الميم) is a substitute for the omitted vocative particle; (إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive; (كان) a deficient past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) —, mabnī, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (ها) particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna; (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); (الحقّ) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحقّ» [Note: Or it is a ḥāl from the meaning of «الحقّ», i.e. "that which is established from You" — al-ʿUkbarī.], and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أمطر) an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أمطر); (حجارة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أمطر) [Note: Or it is a naʿt (adjective) of «حجارة», in the position of the accusative.], (أو) a conjunction; (ائت) like [Translator's note: the source reads «مثل», most likely a misprint for «فعل» (verb)] an imperative, mabnī on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائت); (أليم) naʿt of «عذاب», genitive (majrūr).
The clause «قالوا …» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The vocative clause and its response are in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech) [Note: The vocative clause may be parenthetical and supplicatory, and the clause «كان هذا هو الحقّ» is the maqūl al-qawl.].
The clause «كان هذا …» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «أمطر …» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ائتنا» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.

* Rhetoric:
Istiʿāra (metaphor): in His saying, Exalted is He: «فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ» the speech is a metaphor or a figure (majāz) for «أنزل» (send down).

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (كان) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ); (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); (يعذّب) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of denial, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنت) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of the nominative; (في) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أنت».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعذّبهم) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of kāna.
(الواو) conjunction; (ما كان الله) like the first; (معذّب) khabar of kāna, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (وهم) like «وأنت»; (يستغفرون) imperfect verb, nominative …
and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ما كان الله …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the implied resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «يعذّبهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «أنت فيهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «ما كان الله» (the second) has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ما كان الله» (the first).
The clause «هم مستغفرون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. [Translator's note: the text reads «هم مستغفرون», while the verse has «وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ».]

* Benefits:
1- The lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) is the one preceded by a negated form of kāna; it has been treated in earlier verses, so refer back to it in its places.
And since the lām and the verb were replaced by the active participle, it was put in the accusative as the khabar of kāna. So reflect.

safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
- (الواو) resumptive; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لا) particle of negation; (يعذّب) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يعذّبهم) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted (في), attached to what the preposition and its noun in (لهم) are attached to, i.e. the khabar; the implied meaning is: "What is there for them in the absence of punishment?"
(الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) a pronoun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ; (يصدّون) imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عن المسجد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصدّون); (الحرام) naʿt (adjective) of «المسجد», genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (كانوا) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) —, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (أولياء) khabar of kāna, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) particle of negation; (أولياء) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (الهاء) as before; (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (المتّقون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle of istidrāk (rectification) governing the accusative; (أكثر) the noun of lākinna, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) negating; (يعلمون) like «يصدّون».
The clause «ما لهم …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعذّبهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن). [Translator's note: so in the source, although «أن» is overt in this verse.]
The clause «هم يصدّون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the object pronoun in (يعذّبهم).
The clause «يصدّون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «ما كانوا …» is in the position of the accusative, being conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «إن أولياؤه …» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لكنّ أكثرهم …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إن أولياؤه».
The clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna.

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) particle of negation; (كان) a defective past verb; (صلاة) the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الصلاة» [Note: Or attached to «الصلاة» because it is a maṣdar.]; (البيت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (مكاء) khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (تصدية) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «مكاء», accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (ذوقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الباء) a preposition of causation; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — and its noun; (تكفرون) imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ما كان صلاتهم …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ذوقوا …» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "If this is the nature of your prayer, then taste …".
The clause «كنتم تكفرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تكفرون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تكفرون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (ذوقوا).

* Morphology:
(المكاء): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb مكا يمكو meaning "to whistle"; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ. It falls under an approximate rule, because the verb denotes a sound, so the maṣdar came like بكاء and صراخ. The hamza is converted from a wāw, because its imperfect is يمكو; when the wāw came at the end after a quiescent extra alif, it was turned into a hamza.
(التصدية): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the verb صدّى يصدّي; its pattern is تفعله, and its original form is تصديّ — with kasra on the dāl and a doubled yāʾ —. The doubling on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so the lām of the verb was dropped and the yāʾ of تفعيل remained — or the yāʾ of تفعيل was dropped and the lām of the verb remained — and a tāʾ marbūṭa was substituted for what was dropped, so it became تصدية. «التصدية» means clapping.

* Benefits:
1- The Arabs in the Jāhiliyya used to circumambulate the Kaʿba naked, the men by day and the women by night, interlacing their fingers with one another, whistling through them, then clapping. They claimed that this was prayer. So Allah condemned this practice of theirs, and described the shouting, clamour and clapping that issued from them as «التصدية», as an intensification of disbelief and of the futility of their effort.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
