(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (كفروا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ينفقون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أموال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) of cause (taʿlīl); (يصدّوا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصدّوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) resumptive; (السين) particle of the future; (ينفقون) like the first, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ثمّ) conjunction; (تكون) imperfect verb, nominative, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حسرة) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «حسرة» — an adjective placed before what it qualifies —.], which is the khabar (predicate) of «تكون», accusative; (ثمّ) conjunction; (يغلبون) passive imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفروا) like the first; (إلى جهنّم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحشرون), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (يحشرون) like «يغلبون». The interpreted maṣdar (أن يصدّوا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (ينفقون).
The clause «إنّ الذين كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ينفقون …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يصدّوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «سينفقونها» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تكون … حسرة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «سينفقونها».
The clause «يغلبون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «تكون …».
The clause «الذين كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إنّ الذين كفروا».
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يحشرون» is in the position of the nominative — in the position of the nominative — as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين). [Translator's note: the phrase "in the position of the nominative" is repeated in the source.]

* Morphology:
(حسرة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) [Translator's note: the source has «صدر مرّة», evidently for «مصدر مرّة».] from حسر على الشيء يحسر, of the bāb تعب; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ. Or it is the heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb, and there is another maṣdar, حسرة with two fatḥas [Translator's note: i.e. حَسَر]; or it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تحسّر.

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) of cause (taʿlīl); (يميز) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الخبيث) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (من الطّيب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يميز).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يميز) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يحشرون) or to (يغلبون) in the previous verse … (الخبيث) means the disbeliever and (الطّيب) means the believer.
(الواو) conjunction; (يجعل) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يميز), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الخبيث) like the first; (بعض) badal (substitute) of «الخبيث» — a part from the whole —, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second object of the verb «جعل» [Note: Or attached to the verb «جعل», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) if the verb is transitive to a single object.]; (الفاء) conjunction; (يركم) like «يجعل» and conjoined to it; (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (جميعا) ḥāl, accusative, from the third-person pronoun in (يركمه); (الفاء) conjunction; (يجعله) like «يركمه»; (في جهنّم) like «إلى جهنّم» [Note: In verse (36) of this sūra.], and attached to (يجعل); (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) … and (الكاف) is of address; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is «الخاسرون», and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك».]; (الخاسرون) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «يميز الله …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يجعل …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يميز الله».
The clause «يركمه» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يجعل».
The clause «يجعله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يركمه».
The clause «أولئك … الخاسرون» has no grammatical position, being a resumption carrying the sense of giving the reason (taʿlīl).

safi-cedvel:38-40.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta"; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قل); (كفروا) past verb and its fāʿil; (إن) a conditional particle governing the jussive; (ينتهوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn …
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (يغفر) passive imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يغفر); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (سلف) past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa", which is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) «1»; (الواو) conjunction; (إن يعودوا) like «إن ينتهوا» and conjoined to it; (الفاء) giving the reason (taʿlīliyya); (قد مضت) like «قد سلف», the indeclinability being on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters … and (التاء) is of the feminine; (سنّة) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الأوّلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن ينتهوا …» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يغفر لهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «قد سلف» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) «2».
The clause «إن يعودوا …» is in the position of the accusative, being conjoined to the clause «إن ينتهوا».
The clause «قد مضت سنّة …» has no grammatical position, being the reason for the implied apodosis, i.e. "If they return, We will take vengeance on them, because the way of the former peoples has already passed" [Note: It is permissible to make the clause the apodosis of the condition, in the position of the jussive.
(2, 3) It is permissible for the verb to be defective (nāqiṣ), with (الدين) as its noun and (لله) as its khabar … See verse (193) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]. [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «2» appear in the source text as given; the footnote texts are printed merged in the bracket above.]
(الواو) conjunction; (قاتلوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حتّى) a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; (لا) negating; (تكون) a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after «حتّى»; (فتنة) the fāʿil of «تكون», nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تكون فتنة) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (قاتلوهم).
(الواو) conjunction; (يكون الدين) like «تكون فتنة» and conjoined to it «2»; (كلّ) tawkīd (emphasis) of «الدين», nominative like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الدين» «3»; (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a conditional particle governing the jussive; (انتهوا) past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of the jussive as the protasis … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) giving the reason; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or it is a relative noun or an indefinite qualified noun, and the clause after it is either a ṣila or a naʿt (adjective), the referent pronoun being omitted.] [Translator's note: the source has «إنا», evidently for «إمّا».]; (يعملون) imperfect verb, nominative …
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بصير) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (بصير).
The clause «قاتلوهم …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «قل للذين …».
The clause «لا تكون فتنة …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يكون الدين …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «إن انتهوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive … and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, its implied form being "Allah will recompense them".
The clause «إنّ الله …» has no grammatical position, being the reason for the implied apodosis.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction; (إن تولّوا) like «إن انتهوا»; (الفاء) giving the reason; (اعلموا) like «قاتلوا»; (أنّ الله مولى) like «إنّ الله بصير», and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (نعم) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for the expression of praise; (المولى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif … and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah"; (الواو) conjunction; (نعم النصير) like «نعم المولى».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله مولاكم) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «اعلموا».
The clause «إن تولّوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إن انتهوا».
The clause «اعلموا …» has no grammatical position, being the reason for the omitted apodosis, i.e. "If they turn away, then do not fear their might, because Allah is your Protector" … or the clause is the apodosis of the condition, in the position of the jussive.
The clause «نعم المولى …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It is permissible for (مولاكم) to be an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of the Name of Majesty, and the clause «نعم المولى» the khabar of anna, with «نعم النصير» conjoined to it.].
The clause «نعم النصير» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «نعم المولى».

* Morphology:
(سنّة): a noun meaning "way", "conduct" or "law"; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma then sukūn, and its ʿayn and lām are the same letter.
(مضت): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf): the lām of the verb was dropped because it met, quiescent, with the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; its pattern is فعت.

The remainder of Sūrat al-Anfāl

safi-cedvel:41-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اعلموا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted; (ما) a conditional noun governing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a relative noun, the noun of anna, with what follows the fāʾ as the khabar; the fāʾ was added in the khabar because «ما» resembles the conditional.]; (غنمتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (من شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «غنمتم» [Note: Or it is a tamyīz (specification) of (ما).].
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ ما غنمتم …) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «اعلموا».
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition; (أنّ) like the first [Note: In a construction like this it is also permissible to read the hamza of (أنّ) with kasra.]; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of anna; (خمس) the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لله خمسة …) [Translator's note: so in the source, for «خمسه».] is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "its ruling", i.e. "its ruling is that the fifth belongs to Allah" [Note: It is permissible for the interpreted maṣdar to be a mubtadaʾ with an omitted khabar, i.e. "That a fifth of it belongs to Allah is obligatory".].
(الواو) conjunction in the following five places; (الرسول، ذي، اليتامى، المساكين، ابن) words conjoined to the Name of Majesty, with the preposition repeated in «الرسول» and «ذي» … the sign of the genitive in «ذي» being the yāʾ, and in «اليتامى» an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif; (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on the alif; (السبيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إن) a conditional particle governing the jussive; (كنتم) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb —, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) … and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna [Translator's note: the source has «ناقض», evidently a misprint for «ناقص».]; (آمنتم) like «غنمتم»; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنتم); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the Name of Majesty; (أنزلنا) past verb and its fāʿil; (على عبد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلنا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أنزلنا); (الفرقان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يوم) an adverb, badal (substitute) of the first, accusative; (التقى) past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif; (الجمعان) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the alif; (الواو) parenthetical — or resumptive —; (الله) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (قدير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «اعلموا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «غنمتم من شيء» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «(حكمه) أنّ لله خمسة» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition.
The clause «كنتم آمنتم بالله …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive … and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, its implied form being "then know", or "then comply" …
The clause «آمنتم …» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».
The clause «أنزلنا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «التقى الجمعان» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (يوم) to it.
The clause «الله … قدير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
(إذ) an adverb of past time, in the position of the accusative as a badal of the word «يوم» [Note: Or it is an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" … It is also permissible to attach it, as an adverb, to «قدير».]; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (بالعدوة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of «العدوة», genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (هم بالعدوة القصوى) like «أنتم بالعدوة الدنيا»; (الواو) conjunction; (الركب) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أسفل) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أسفل). (الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional; (تواعدتم) like «غنمتم»; (اللام) linking the apodosis of «لو»; (اختلفتم) like «غنمتم»; (في الميعاد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اختلفتم); (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of istidrāk (rectification); (اللام) of cause (taʿlīl); (يقضي) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (أمرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقضي) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He gathered you" [Note: Or its implied form is "You did not make an appointment, so that Allah might accomplish a matter".].
(كان) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb —, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (مفعولا) khabar of kāna, accusative; (ليهلك) like «ليقضي»; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (هلك) past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (عن بيّنة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهلك); (الواو) conjunction; (يحيا) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to «يهلك», the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa on the alif [Translator's note: the source has «وعلامة النصب والفتحة», with a stray «و».]; (من حيّ عن بيّنة) like «من هلك عن بيّنة», and the preposition is attached to (يحيا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهلك) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (مفعولا) [Note: It is permissible for it to be a badal of the interpreted maṣdar (أن يقضي), with the preposition repeated, so that it is attached to what the first is attached to.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحيا) is in the position of the genitive by an implied lām, attached to what the interpreted maṣdar «أن يهلك» is attached to, for it is conjoined to it.
(الواو) resumptive; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (سميع) khabar of inna, nominative; (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «أنتم بالعدوة …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «هم بالعدوة القصوى» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «أنتم بالعدوة».
The clause «الركب أسفل …» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «أنتم بالعدوة».
The clause «تواعدتم …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اختلفتم …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يقضي الله …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «كان مفعولا» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (أمرا).
The clause «يهلك …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «هلك …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «يحيا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «يهلك».
The clause «حيّ …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «إنّ الله لسميع …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أنّ ما): written joined in the muṣḥaf, though its due was to be written separately; it is written separately in some copies of the muṣḥaf.
(خمس): a noun for one part of five parts; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas; its plural is أخماس, on the pattern أفعال.
(العدوة): a noun meaning the side of the valley or its edge; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(القصوى): the feminine of أقصى; the wāw in it is original, and its form departs from the norm of analogy, since the analogy of usage is that it should be قصيا, because it is an adjective like دنيا and عليا …
For فعلى, when it is an adjective, has its wāw turned into a yāʾ to distinguish between the noun and the adjective. Its pattern is فعلى with ḍamma then sukūn. أقصى has the pattern أفعل; its original form is أقصو: the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was turned into an alif.
(الركب): a collective noun (ism jamʿ); it has been said that it is the plural of راكب in meaning but not in form, because we say in its diminutive ركيب. Its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الميعاد): a mīmī maṣdar — not regular — meaning mutual appointment; its original form is موعاد: the wāw came quiescent after a kasra and was turned into a yāʾ, so it contains a weak-letter change by conversion (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb).

* Rhetoric:
1- The device of istidrāk (rectification): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَلكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْراً كانَ مَفْعُولًا», where Allah, Glorified and Exalted, made clear that their victory in such a situation was nothing but the doing of Allah, Glorified, and a proof that it was a matter made possible only by His might, His power and His dazzling omnipotence. For the far side of the valley (العدوة القصوى), where the polytheists had made camp, had water in it and was tolerable ground, whereas there was no water on the near side (العدوة الدنيا), and it was soft ground with stones, in which the feet sank.
2- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the words of Allah the Exalted «لِيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيى مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ»,
where perishing and living are borrowed for disbelief and Islam, i.e. so that the disbelief of whoever disbelieves may issue from the clarity of a clear proof, not from the stirring of a doubt, so that he has no argument left against Allah; and the Islam of whoever embraces Islam may likewise issue from certainty and knowledge that it is the religion of truth which must be entered and held fast to.

* Benefits:
This noble verse contains an explanation of the division of the spoils: they are five fifths: for Allah, for the Messenger, for the near of kin, the orphans, the needy and the wayfarer.
The scholars differed on whether ghanīma (spoils of war) and fayʾ are one and the same thing, or whether they differ. The correct view is that they differ. Fayʾ is what is taken from the wealth of the disbelievers without spurring horses or camels [i.e. without fighting], and ghanīma is what is taken from their wealth by force. So Allah, Glorified and Exalted, mentioned in this verse the ruling on ghanīma: it is five fifths …
1- For Allah: most of the exegetes and jurists have stated that «لله» is an opening of speech by way of seeking blessing.
The scholars said: the share of Allah and the share of His Messenger are one.
The spoils are divided into five fifths: four fifths of them go to those who fought and secured them, and the remaining fifth to the five categories that Allah the Exalted mentioned.
The share of Allah and His Messenger, during his lifetime, he would apportion to whatever interests he saw fit; after his death, it is for the interests of the Muslims and whatever gives strength to Islam. This is the view of al-Shāfiʿī and Aḥmad.
2- «وَلِذِي الْقُرْبى»: meaning that a share of the fifth of the fifth belongs to the near of kin, who are the relatives of the Prophet ﷺ, namely Banū Hāshim and Banū al-Muṭṭalib, according to the view of Imam al-Shāfiʿī, relying on a hadith in Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī.
3- The orphans: they are the young children of the Muslims who have no father.
4- The needy: they are the people of want and need among the Muslims.
5- The wayfarer: he is the traveller far from his wealth; he is given from the fifth of the fifth when he needs it. This is the division of the fifth. As for the rest of the spoils, it is given to the fighters: the horseman gets three shares, two for his horse and one for himself, and the foot soldier is given one share. This is the view of most of the people of knowledge, among them al-Thawrī, al-Awzāʿī, Mālik, al-Shāfiʿī, Ibn al-Mubārak, Aḥmad and Isḥāq. Abū Ḥanīfa said: the horseman is given two shares and the foot soldier one share.
Placing the khabar before the mubtadaʾ:
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted (فإن لله خمسه). It is noticeable that the noun of inna has been delayed and its khabar, which is a semi-clause (shibh jumla: the semi-clause means the adverb or the preposition with its genitive noun), has been placed first. Accordingly we parse (لله) as a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar, its implied form being «مستقر» or «استقر», and we parse «خمسه» as the delayed noun of inna. To complete the benefit, we shall present the cases in which the khabar must precede the mubtadaʾ:
1- When the mubtadaʾ is indefinite and the khabar is a semi-clause, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصاصِ حَياةٌ».
2- When the mubtadaʾ contains a pronoun referring back to part of the khabar, as when we say (في الدار ساكنها) "In the house is its dweller"; this is so that the pronoun does not refer to something that comes later both in wording and in rank.
3- When the khabar is one of the nouns that must come first (asmāʾ al-ṣadāra), such as interrogative nouns, as in the words of Allah the Exalted (أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ؟).
4- When the khabar is restricted to the mubtadaʾ, as when we say: «ما شاعر إلا أنت» "There is no poet but you"; here we have restricted the addressee to the quality of being a poet, in which no one rivals him.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; (يريك) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ … and (الكاف) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) a pronoun, second mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (في منام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يري), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قليلا) third mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (أرى) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif, and (الكاف) a pronoun, first object, and (هم) a pronoun, second object, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (كثيرا) third mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (اللام) linking the apodosis of the condition; (فشلتم) like «آمنتم» [Note: In verse (41) of this sūra.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لتنازعتم) like «لفشلتم»; (في الأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تنازعتم); (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —, and (الهاء) a pronoun, the noun of inna; (عليم) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative; (بذات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم); (الصدور) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). [Translator's note: the parsing of «اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُ» is missing from the source between «لكنّ» and «الهاء», and «مشبّه للفعل» is so written for «مشبّه بالفعل».]
The clause «يريكهم الله …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لو أراكهم …» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «يريكهم».
The clause «فشلتم …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تنازعتم …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «فشلتم».
The clause «لكنّ الله سلّم» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «أراكهم».
The clause «سلّم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna.
The clause «إنّه عليم …» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(منامك): a mīmī maṣdar of the triliteral verb نام, meaning sleep; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn. It contains a weak-letter change by conversion (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb): its original form is منوم, with sukūn on the nūn and fatḥa on the wāw; then the vowel of the wāw, the fatḥa, was transferred to the nūn; then the wāw was turned into an alif because it was originally vowelled after a fatḥa, and it became مناما.

* Benefits:
The hamza of transitivity (hamzat al-taʿdiya):
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted «إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنامِكَ قَلِيلًا». We know that the verb رأى is transitive to two objects, but in this verse it is transitive to three objects: the kāf is the first object, the hāʾ the second object and «قليلا» the third object. The reason for this is the entry of the hamza of transitivity on this verb: its origin is رأى يرى, and when the hamza of transitivity entered it became أرى يرى. Likewise this hamza, when it enters an intransitive verb, makes it transitive to one object, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً» and «وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعى»: the two verbs نزل and خرج are intransitive, but they became transitive through the entry of the hamza. Likewise a verb transitive to one object becomes transitive to two objects, as in:
أربحتك الجائزة ("I made you win the prize"): the kāf is the first object and «الجائزة» the second object. And likewise, if it is transitive to two objects, it becomes transitive to three, as has passed in the noble verse.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ يريكموهم … قليلا) like «إذ يريكم قليلا» [Note: In the previous verse (43).], and the wāw in the verb is redundant (zāʾida), being the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa", i.e. Allah; (إذ) an indeclinable (mabnī) adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يري) — and its meaning is past, because it is the narration of the warring parties —; (التقيتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (في أعين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قليلا), which is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), from the hāʾ in (يريكموهم) [Note: Because the seeing here is visual.], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يقلّل) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (في أعينهم) like «في أعينكم», attached to (يقلل); (ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا): its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (42) of this sūra.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقضي) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يقلّلكم), or to the two verbs (يريكموهم ويقللكم).
(الواو) resumptive; (إلى الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ترجع), which is a passive imperfect verb, nominative; (الأمور) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative.
The clause «يريكموهم …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «التقيتم …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يقلّلكم …» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «يريكموهم».
The clause «يقضي الله …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «كان مفعولا» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (أمرا).
The clause «ترجع الأمور» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

safi-cedvel:45-47.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle; (أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative … and (ها) is for drawing attention (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of «أيّ»; (آمنوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of the condition, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (لقيتم) like «التقيتم» [Note: In the previous verse (44).]; (فئة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition; (تثبتوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so written in the source; the verse has «فَاثْبُتُوا»]; (الواو) conjunction; (اذكروا) like «اثبتوا»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كثيرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is its adjective; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —, and (كم) a pronoun, the noun of laʿalla; (تفلحون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يأيّها الذين آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis … has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «لقيتم …» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (إذا) to it.
The clause «اثبتوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «اذكروا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «اثبتوا».
The clause «لعلّكم تفلحون» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تفلحون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.
(الواو) conjunction; (أطيعوا الله) like «اذكروا الله»; (الواو) conjunction; (رسول) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) of prohibition, governing the jussive; (تنازعوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), from which one of the two tāʾs has been dropped, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تفشلوا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (وتذهب) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تفشلوا); (ريح) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفشلوا) is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the meaning of the preceding prohibition, i.e. "Let there be no disputing among you, and so failure".
(الواو) conjunction; (اصبروا) like «اثبتوا»; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of inna; (الصابرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أطيعوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the apodosis «اثبتوا».
The clause «لا تنازعوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أطيعوا الله».
The clause «تفشلوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تذهب ريحكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «تفشلوا».
The clause «اصبروا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أطيعوا».
The clause «إنّ الله مع الصابرين» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (تكونوا) a defective imperfect verb — an abrogating verb —, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of «تكون»; (الكاف) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of «تكونوا»; (خرجوا) like «آمنوا»; (من ديار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خرجوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بطرا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative.]; (الواو) conjunction; (رئاء) conjoined to (بطرا), accusative; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (يصدّون) like «تفلحون»; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصدّون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (يعملون) like «تفلحون»; (محيط) khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (محيط).
The clause «لا تكونوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لا تنازعوا».
The clause «خرجوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يصدّون …» is in the position of the accusative, being conjoined to the single-word ḥāl «بطرا» [Note: If the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar — which is far-fetched — the interpreted maṣdar would be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi by conjunction, in the position of the accusative.].
The clause «الله … محيط» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما) [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a relative noun from which the referent pronoun has been dropped, with the clause as its ṣila, i.e. «بما يعملونه» "of what they do" …].

* Morphology:
(تنازعوا): one of the two tāʾs in the verb was dropped for lightness; its original form is تتنازعوا.
(بطرا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb بطر يبطر, of the bāb فرح; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the words of Allah the Exalted «فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ», i.e. your power and your strength would go. For «الريح» (wind) is borrowed for power, in that power, in the course of its affairs and their execution, is likened to the wind in its blowing and its flowing.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; (زيّن) past verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّن); (الشيطان) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (أعمال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (قال) like «زيّن», and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (غالب) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (لكم) like «لهم», attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the khabar of lā [Note: It is not permissible for «اليوم» to be attached to (غالب), nor for (من الناس) to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «غالب», because the noun of lā, when it governs, is declined.]; (من الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the pronoun in (لكم), the governing factor being the meaning of negation; (الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis governing the accusative, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (جار) khabar, nominative; (لكم) like «لهم», attached to (جار). (الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of the condition, attached to (نكص); (تراءت) past verb … and (التاء) is of the feminine; (الفئتان) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif; (نكص) like «زيّن», and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (على عقبي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نكص) [Note: Or it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.], the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (قال) like «زيّن»; (إنّي بريء منكم) like «إنّي جار لكم»; (إنّي) like the first; (أرى) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It is permissible for it to be an indefinite noun meaning "a thing".]; (لا) particle of negation; (ترون) imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إنّي أخاف الله) like «إنّي أرى ما …»; (الواو) resumptive — or conjunction. (الله شديد) like «الله محيط» [Note: In the previous verse (47).]; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «زيّن لهم الشيطان …» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (إذا) to it. [Translator's note: so in the source, for «إذ».]
The clause «قال …» is in the position of the genitive, being conjoined to the clause «زيّن».
The clause «قال …» is in the position of the genitive accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: so in the source; this line appears garbled, and the following line gives «لا غالب لكم» as the maqūl al-qawl.]
The clause «لا غالب لكم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «إنّي جار لكم» is in the position of the accusative, being conjoined to the clause «لا غالب لكم» [Note: It is permissible for it to be a ḥāl after the wāw of the ḥāl, i.e. "No one will overcome you, while I am a jār to you", i.e. a protector.].
The clause «تراءت الفئتان …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نكص …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition (لمّا).
The clause «قال …» (the second) has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «نكص».
The clause «إنّي بريء منكم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «إنّي أرى …» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أرى ما لا ترون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «لا ترون …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنّي أخاف …» has no grammatical position, being a resumption to emphasise the first.
The clause «أخاف الله …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (إنّ).
The clause «الله شديد …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It is permissible to conjoin it to the clause of the object of the saying, as being part of the rest of Satan's words.].

* Rhetoric:
The representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the words of Allah the Exalted «فَلَمَّا تَراءَتِ الْفِئَتانِ نَكَصَ عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ», i.e. he went back in retreat; for the retreating was at the time of meeting, not at the time of seeing one another. So there is a representational metaphor in the speech: the coming to nothing of his scheme after his embellishment is likened to one who goes back in retreat from what he fears, as if it were said: "When the two met, his scheme came to nothing, and what he had made them imagine to be their protector became the cause of their destruction."

* Benefits:
The particle (لمّا).
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted «فَلَمَّا تَراءَتِ الْفِئَتانِ نَكَصَ عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ». The word (لما) occurs in the noble verse, and it is an adverb meaning "when"; it is parsed as a particle of existence for existence (ḥarf wujūd li-wujūd) or a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb). We shall set out below the different uses of this word:
1- It is specific to the imperfect, putting it in the jussive, negating it and converting it to the past, its negation continuing up to the time of speaking, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذابِ» and the words of Allah the Exalted «وَلكِنْ قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ».
2- It is specific to the past, and requires two clauses, the second of which came into existence upon the existence of the first, as in «لما جاءني أكرمته» ("When he came to me, I honoured him"). It is called a particle of existence for existence, and some call it a particle of necessity for necessity. Ibn al-Sarrāj claimed — and al-Fārisī followed him, and Ibn Jinnī followed them both, and a group followed them too — that it is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna). Ibn Mālik said it means «إذ», and that is good, because it is specific to the past, in addition to being annexed to the clause. Its apodosis is, by agreement, a past verb, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ», or a clause joined with the «إذا» of surprise, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ».
3- It comes as a particle of exception, entering the nominal clause, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْها حافِظٌ», and it enters a verb that is past in form but not in meaning, as in: (أنشدك الله لما فعلت) "I adjure you by Allah, do but do it", i.e. "I ask of you nothing but that you do it".

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ) badal (substitute) of the preceding one, in the position of the accusative; (يقول) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (المنافقون) fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the fāʿil; (في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (مرض) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (غرّ) past verb; (ها) for drawing attention (tanbīh); (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (دين) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun governing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يتوكّل) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتوكّل); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (عزيز) khabar of inna, nominative; (حكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يقول المنافقون …» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «في قلوبهم مرض» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «غرّ هؤلاء دينهم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «من يتوكّل …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يتوكّل على الله …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.] …
The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition is omitted, indicated by the content of the speech after it, i.e. "he will prevail".
The clause «إنّ الله عزيز …» has no grammatical position, being the reason for the implied apodosis, or an explanation of it.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (ترى) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, "anta", and its object is omitted, i.e. the disbelievers or their state; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ترى) [Note: Because it has a past meaning.]; (يتوفّى) (الذين) imperfect verb, nominative, like «ترى» … a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كفروا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma …
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الملائكة) fāʿil, nominative [Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause «يضربون», the clause being a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the fāʿil of (يتوفّى) being a pronoun referring to Allah.]; (يضربون) imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (وجوه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أدبارهم) like «وجوههم» and conjoined to it; (الواو) conjunction; (ذوقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الحريق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «ترى …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يتوفّى … الملائكة» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يضربون …» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from «الملائكة».
The clause «ذوقوا …» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "they say to them: taste …"; and the implied clause is in the position of the accusative, being conjoined to the clause «يضربون».
The apodosis of (لو) is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen a tremendous thing".

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the punishment, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun or an indefinite qualified noun, in the position of the genitive, the referent pronoun being omitted … and the clause is either a ṣila or a naʿt (adjective).]; (قدّمت) past verb, and (التاء) is of the feminine; (أيدي) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما قدّمت …) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «ذلك».
(الواو) conjunction; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (ليس) a defective, inflexible (jāmid) past verb — an abrogating verb —, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (ظلّام) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of laysa; (اللام) redundant, for strengthening (taqwiya); (العبيد) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the intensive form «ظلّام».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله …) is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar (ما قدّمت).
The clause «ذلك بما قدّمت أيديكم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قدّمت أيديكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «ليس بظلّام …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna.

* Rhetoric:
1- The non-metaphorical trope (al-majāz al-mursal): in His words «بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ», the sending forth of the hands is a trope for earning and doing, i.e. that befalls you because of what you have earned of disbelief and sins. The relation is causality, because the hand is the instrument of beneficence, just as it has been used figuratively in the sense of beneficence. [Translator's note: so in the source.]
2- The words of Allah the Exalted «وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ»: He turned from «ظالم» to «ظلّام». The apparent sense of the speech would have required negating the lower degree, because that is more eloquent than negating the higher, since negating the higher does not entail negating the lower, and vice versa. But He turned from that for the sake of «العبيد» (the many servants), or because the punishment is so great that, were it not deserved, the one who inflicts the like of it would be «ظلّام», extremely and grievously unjust.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(كدأب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the custom of these"; (آل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, conjoined by the conjunction to «آل فرعون»; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, like the preceding [Note: In verse (50) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: the parsing of «كفروا» is not given separately in the source; the phrase "like the preceding" appears to refer to it.]; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كفروا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) conjunction; (أخذ) past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (بذنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذ), the bāʾ being of causation, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ الله قويّ شديد) like «إنّ الله عزيز حكيم» [Note: In verse (49) of this sūra.]; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «(دأبهم) كدأب آل فرعون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أخذهم الله …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «كفروا».
The clause «إنّ الله قويّ …» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
Simile (tashbīh): in the words of Allah the Exalted «كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ» there is a statement that the punishment that befell them was because of their disbelief and nothing else, since their state is likened to the state of those well known for having been destroyed for that reason, to increase the ugliness of their state, and to draw attention to the fact that this is a constant law among the nations that were destroyed.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) like the preceding «1»; (الباء) a preposition; (أنّ الله): its i'rab has passed «2»; (لم) a particle of negation and of the jussive; (يك) a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the sukūn, overt on the nūn that was dropped for lightness, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (مغيّرا) khabar (predicate) of «يك», accusative (manṣūb); (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle (مغيّرا); (أنعم) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa", and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنعم); (حتّى) a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; (يغيّروا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتّى»; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (بأنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يغيّروا) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (مغيّرا); (الواو) conjunction; (أنّ الله سميع عليم) like «إنّ الله عزيز حكيم» [Note: In verse (49) of this sūra.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله لم يك …) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله سميع …) is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله لم يك …).
The clause «ذلك بأنّ الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لم يك …» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna.
The clause «أنعمها …» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمة».
The clause «يغيّروا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
[Translator's note: the markers «1» and «2» are in the source text without accompanying footnote text here.]

* Morphology:
(يك): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) suited to the jussive, because it is a hollow weak verb: its ʿayn was dropped, its original form being يكون. It also contains the dropping of the nūn for lightness [Note: The conditions for the dropping are met in it, namely: an imperfect in the jussive followed by a vowelled letter.]; its pattern is يف.
(مغيّرا): active participle of the quadriliteral غيّر; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
Dropping the nūn of (يكن) for lightness:
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted «ذلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّراً نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَها عَلى قَوْمٍ حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا ما بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ». It is noticeable that the nūn has been dropped from «يكن» in the words of Allah the Exalted «لَمْ يَكُ». The grammarians have permitted dropping the nūn of «يكن» for lightness on conditions:
1- That the verb be in the jussive with the sukūn, i.e. not attached to a pronoun.
2- That the word following it not begin with a quiescent letter, as in «لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم»; in this position dropping the nūn is not permissible. This occurs often in the Noble Qur'an, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا». I parse it thus: «أك» is a defective imperfect verb that puts the first in the nominative and the second in the accusative, in the jussive by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, implied on the nūn dropped for lightness.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(كدأب آل فرعون … بذنوبهم): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In verse (52) of this sūra.]; (الواو) conjunction; (أغرقنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn … and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and like it is (أهلكنا) before it; (آل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (الواو) conjunction; (كلّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: Beginning with an indefinite was permissible because it is intended to be annexed, i.e. "all of the people of Pharaoh and those before them …",
and because it indicates generality.]; (كانوا) a defective past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) —, and the wāw is the noun of kāna, in the position of the nominative; (ظالمين) khabar (predicate) of «كانوا», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «(دأبهم) كدأب …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا …» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أهلكناهم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «كذّبوا».
The clause «أغرقنا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أهلكناهم».
The clause «كلّ كانوا …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانوا ظالمين» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ).

safi-cedvel:55-57.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) —; (شرّ) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (الدوابّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) «شرّ»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna; (كفروا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) giving the reason (taʿlīliyya); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) particle of negation; (يؤمنون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ شرّ الدوابّ …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position, giving the reason — or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) —. The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».
(الذين) badal (substitute) of the first [Note: It is permissible for it to be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they", or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause «إمّا تثقفنّهم …», the fāʾ entering because the mubtadaʾ resembles the conditional. It is also permissible to cut it off from being an adjective, for censure, so that it is in the position of the accusative.]; (عاهدت) past verb and its fāʿil; (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted referent pronoun [Note: Or to the verb «عاهدت», by giving it the implied sense of «أخذت» ("you took"). Or (من) is partitive.]; (ثمّ) conjunction; (ينقضون) imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عهد) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينقضون); (مرّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (هم لا يتّقون) like «هم لا يؤمنون».
The clause «عاهدت …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ينقضون …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هم لا يتّقون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «ينقضون» [Note: It may also be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl after the wāw of the ḥāl.].
The clause «لا يتّقون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».
(الفاء) conjunction [Note: Or it is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar, because the mubtadaʾ resembles the conditional.]; (إن) a conditional particle governing the jussive; (ما) a redundant particle; (تثقفنّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) … and (النون) is for emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (هم) mafʿūl bihi; (في الحرب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تثقفنّهم); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition; (شرّد) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (الباء) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (شرّ), the bāʾ being of causation [Translator's note: so in the source, evidently for «شرّد»]; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (خلف) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of «من», and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle —, and (هم) a pronoun, the noun of laʿalla, in the position of the accusative; (يذّكّرون) like «يؤمنون».
The clause «تثقفنّهم …» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «إنّ شرّ الدواب».
The clause «شرّد بهم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition.
The clause «لعلّهم يذّكّرون» has no grammatical position, giving the reason — or an explanatory resumption —. The clause «يذّكّرون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(يسألون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn – and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of the accusative; (عن الأنفال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسألون), (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «you» (أنت); (الأنفال) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (الواو) conjunctive; (الرسول) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr); (الفاء) to link the apodosis to an implied condition; (اتّقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunctive; (أصلحوا) like اتّقوا; (ذات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (بين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (أطيعوا) like اتقوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, like the first; (الواو) conjunctive; (رسول) conjoined to the Name of Majesty, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) an incomplete past verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as ism of kāna; (مؤمنين) khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يسألونك..» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الأنفال لله ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of saying).
The clause «اتقوا الله ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. if you believe in this, then fear Allah.
The clause «أصلحوا ...» is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.
The clause «أطيعوا ...» is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position: an explanation of the implied condition.. and the apodosis of the second condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: if you are believers, then fear Allah and set right.. and obey.

* Morphology:
(الأنفال): plural of نفل, a noun meaning spoils of war; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas, and the pattern of الأنفال is أفعال.

* Benefits:
1- The root (سأل): if the asking is about intellectual or abstract matters, the verb is made transitive with «عن», as in the verse «يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفالِ», i.e. about their ruling; and if it is to request a material thing, it takes two objects, e.g.: سألت الكريم معونة للفقراء (I asked the generous man for help for the poor).
2- From the story of the spoils (al-anfāl): «setting right relations between you» (إصلاح ذات البين). ʿUbāda ibn al-Ṣāmit said: The verse of al-Anfāl was revealed about us – the company of those who were present at Badr – when we had differed over the division of «the spoils» (النفل), which were our booty on the day of Badr, and our conduct had turned bad over it. So Allah took it out of our hands and gave it to the Messenger of Allah, who divided it justly among the Muslims; and in that was the fear of Allah, obedience to His Messenger, and the setting right of relations between them.

safi-cedvel:2-4.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) a restraining [mā] and the restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (المؤمنون) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis وجلت..; (ذكر) past verb, passive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (وجلت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (قلوب) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (إذا تليت.. آياته) like ذكر الله, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تليت), (زادت) like وجلت, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «it» (هي), i.e. the verses, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إيمانا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunctive; (على ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّلون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يتوكّلون) like يسألون [Note: In verse (1) of this sūra.].
The clause «المؤمنون الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ذكر الله» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «وجلت قلوبهم» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تليت.. آياته» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «زادتهم ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause of the second condition, its verb and its apodosis has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the first condition.
The clause «يتوكّلون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the first condition, which is the ṣila clause [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, and it may be in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of زادتهم.
(2, 3) In verse (1) of this sūra.].
(الذين) badal (substitute) of the first relative – or its naʿt (adjective) –; (يقيمون) like يسألون (2), (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (ينفقون), (رزقنا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ينفقون) like يسألون (3).
The clause «يقيمون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «رزقناهم» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ينفقون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يقيمون.
(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is المؤمنون, the nominal clause being the khabar of أولئك.] (المؤمنون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (حقّا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) confirming the content of the preceding «volume» (المجلد) [Translator's note: so in the source; الجملة («clause») is evidently meant.] [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), being its adjective, i.e. the believers with a true faith.], (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (درجات) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to درجات in the sense of rewards [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of درجات.], (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (مغفرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to درجات, nominative, and likewise (رزق); (كريم) naʿt of رزق, nominative.
The clause «أولئك.. المؤمنون» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لهم درجات ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the pronoun latent in (المؤمنون).

safi-cedvel:5-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الكاف) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (أخرج) past verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ربّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من بيت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجك), and (الكاف) like the last; (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of أخرجك, i.e. clothed with the truth [Note: Or attached to the verb أخرجك, i.e. He brought you out because of the truth that would become manifest.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أخرجك) is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, attached to the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «the situation» or «your division of the spoils» [Note: The preposition phrase may be attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. the spoils were established with an establishing like your bringing out with the truth.. There are other views on the attachment of the preposition phrase; Abū Ḥayyān in al-Baḥr made them fifteen views transmitted from the exegetes, among them: – attaching it to a mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by أصلحوا, i.e. set right relations between you with a setting right like your bringing out from your house, with a shift (iltifāt) in it from addressing the group to addressing the individual. b- or to a mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by أطيعوا, i.e. obey Allah and His Messenger like your bringing out from your house with the truth, i.e. a realised obedience. c- or to a mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by يتوكّلون, i.e. they rely with a reliance like your bringing out. d- or it is an adjective of (حقّا) from their saying هم المؤمنون حقا, i.e. truly, like the bringing out.. e- or to a mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by كارهون, i.e. they dislike with a dislike like your bringing out ...
Abū Ḥayyān rejected all of that, saying: «... Before writing down these views in al-Baḥr, when none of them had settled in my mind, I saw in a dream that I was walking with a man, discussing the verse with him, and I said to him: Nothing as problematic as this has come to me in the Qur'an; perhaps there is something omitted by which the meaning becomes sound, and I have not found anything substantial on it from any of the exegetes. Then I said to him: That omitted thing is «your victory» (نصرك). That man and I both found this derivation good; then I woke from sleep while remembering it ...» etc.].
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) –; (فريقا) ism of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (من المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريقا), (اللام) it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (كارهون) khabar of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «أخرجك ربّك ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause «إنّ فريقا.. كارهون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the object pronoun in (أخرجك).
(يجادلون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (في الحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يجادلون; (بعد) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يجادلون), (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (تبيّن) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «it» (هو), i.e. the truth, which is the fighting.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تبيّن..) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(كأنّما) a restraining [mā] and the restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يساقون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative..
and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلى الموت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يساقون), (الواو) circumstantial; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (ينظرون) like يجادلون.
The clause «يجادلونك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: It may be a ḥāl of the pronoun in كارهون.].
The clause «يساقون ...» has no grammatical position: another resumption [Note: It may be a second ḥāl of the pronoun of كارهون.].
The clause «هم ينظرون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «ينظرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Rhetoric:
Representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the noble verse, where his – upon him be peace – being singled out with the spoils, and the entrusting of their matter to his judgment as regards reward and recompense, is likened to his being brought out of his house obedient to Allah the Exalted, hearing His command, content with His judgment, despite the believers' dislike of that in obedience. So Allah the Exalted likened his reward with this distinction to his approved obedience: just as his obedience reached the utmost in the kind of acts of obedience, so too Allah's rewarding of him reached the utmost in the genus of rewards.
Representative simile: in this noble verse, their state in the extremity of their fright and terror – while they were being led to victory and booty – is likened to the state of one who is led to slaughter.

* Benefits:
3- The parsers' disagreement about «كما»: no one among the grammarians and exegetes remained who did not put in his bucket on its i'rab, and the views reached about fifteen. Were it not for the length, we would have set before you the sum of the grammarians' views and their implied forms. Although they almost come out of a single niche, what I feel to be sound is that the simile turns on two situations. The first: the believers' disagreement over the distribution of the spoils, so that ʿUbāda ibn al-Ṣāmit said of it: «our conduct turned bad over it, so Allah took it out of our hands».
The second: their stance towards the Messenger's call to meet the army of Quraysh, and their inclination to meet the caravan (al-ʿīr) instead of the armed force (al-nafīr). So the kāf is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the simile stands between two situations, both of which were heavy for the believers and which they disliked; as though He, Glorified is He, says: this situation is like the situation of such-and-such.. And if you are one of those with grammatical ambitions, turn to the lengthy works, for in them is what cools the breast and quenches the thirst.

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إمّا تخافنّ) like «إمّا تثقفنّ» «1»; (من قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «خيانة» — an adjective placed before what it qualifies —; (خيانة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (فانبذ إليهم) like «فشرّد بهم» «2», and the object of «انبذ» is omitted, i.e. the covenant; (على سواء) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) and the object together, i.e. "in a state of your being equal with them", or "in a state of their being equal with you" … in knowledge of the breaking of the covenant; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (لا) negating; (يحبّ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الخائنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «تخافنّ …» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «انبذ …» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله لا يحبّ …» has no grammatical position, having the status of giving the reason (taʿlīl).
The clause «لا يحب الخائنين» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
[Translator's note: the markers «1» and «2» are in the source text without accompanying footnote text here.]

* Morphology:
(خيانة): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb خان يخون, of the bāb نصر; its pattern is فعالة with kasra on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars: خون, with fatḥa on the khāʾ and sukūn on the wāw, and خانة … then a mīmī maṣdar, مخانة, with fatḥa on the mīm.

* Rhetoric:
1- The implicit imaginative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya al-takhyīliyya): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَإِمَّا تَخافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيانَةً», fear is borrowed for knowledge, i.e. "If you come to know, of a people in covenant with you, a breaking of the covenant in what is to come, through the signs that appear to you from them, «فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ»".
2- The device of allusion (fann al-ishāra): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَإِمَّا تَخافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيانَةً فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلى سَواءٍ».
